name: Crate of Lightforge Ingots
label: Item
description: In Duskwood, the Crate of Lightforge Ingots carries hope against Morbent Fel. The rare consecrated metal is bound for the Dwarven District in Stormwind.
intro: In Duskwood, the Crate of Lightforge Ingots carries hope against Morbent Fel. The rare consecrated metal is bound for the Dwarven District in Stormwind.

p: Duskwood's hope rests in this crate of lightforge iron. The rare metal can channel holy power against dark entities, while Morbent Fel's protections turn aside ordinary steel. Only an artisan who knows its temper and honors its sacred nature can work it.
